description: Compare two people's birth charts (synastry): their top five connections between planets with plain meanings, how attraction, communication, emotional fit and friction look, how their Sun elements meet, and their Venus and Mars chemistry, with a link to the free synastry page. Use when someone asks "are we compatible", "our synastry", "compatibility by birthday", "is my Venus good with their Mars" or names two signs and wants a match. Exact aspects from an ephemeris checked against the Swiss Ephemeris, not sign stereotypes. Times and places are optional for both; without them aspects that depend on the time are marked and the Ascendant is left out. Takes birth details only, never names or contact details, and stores nothing. It describes tendencies for reflection, never a verdict on whether a relationship will work or last.

them.description: Birth details of the other person, only what the user chose to share. No name or contact details.

birth_place.description: Birthplace as city, region, country, e.g. Austin, Texas, United States. Gives coordinates (and the time zone if time_zone is left out).

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Leave out if unknown.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude, if the city is not found. Optional.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude (east positive), with latitude. Optional.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. America/Chicago. Work it out from the birthplace. Needed with a birth_time unless birth_place is in our list.
